title: 1996 Topps X-Files Season 2 #59 Our Town Trading Card
descriptionText: The Topps 1996 X-Files Season Two #59 trading card features an image from the popular TV series "The X-Files." Manufactured by Topps, this non-sport trading card captures a moment from the show's second season. Collectors can add this card to their collection to commemorate a specific episode or character from the franchise.
